title: events.jsonl event (v1, proposed — report §7, ADR-0005)
description: v1 adds the fields the §7 metrics need. Fields marked x-emitted-today: false are not emitted by the owner's log_event.py (docs/baseline.md); the logger change is in the owner's code. This file is PROTECTED once added to PROTECTED.paths (report §9).

event.description: Event name (baseline field); v1 adds task_outcome and memory_stat (report §7).

cost_usd.description: Cost in USD (baseline hook field); OTel is primary for cost, M7 (report §7).

verification.description: Hook-run verification of DONE_WHEN (report §7 M1; ADR-0005).

exit_code.description: Exit code of the hook re-run of DONE_WHEN; M1, M2 (report §7, G3).

verified_by_hook.description: True when the hook, not the Worker's self-report, re-ran DONE_WHEN; M1, M2, M5 (report §7, G11).

guardrail.description: Guardrail id such as G3 on a guardrail_hit event; M9 (report §7).

blocked.description: True when the guardrail blocked the action (ADR-0001 adds blocked: true events); M9 (report §7).

rule_version.description: Version of the guardrail rule that fired; M9 (report §7).

tool_input.description: Subset of tool_input logged for Edit/Write/Bash; M11 (report §7). Not logged by the owner's hook today.

file_path.description: Path touched by an Edit/Write call; M11 (report §7).

bash_command_hash.description: Hash of a Bash command, used instead of raw text for privacy; M11 (report §7).

from_memory_ids.description: Memory entry ids the Advisor reused (today only hit/none is parsed); M13 (report §7, §4).

memory_stat.description: Daily memory index stats for the memory_stat event; M12 (report §7).

config_version.description: Git tag of the installed config (rsi-v<n>); M17 (report §5 rollout, §7; ADR-0005). Also an OTel resource attribute.
